info.title: otel-exporter
info.description: The route otel-exporter serves. Every path is relative to the mount the host assigns, and the host serves this document rebased under it at <mount>/openapi.json.

get.summary: Whether the fleet's telemetry reaches the collector
get.description: Whether the module is reading the host's event stream, and whether its latest metric and trace exports reached the OTLP collector. A failure is reported while it is the latest outcome and is cleared by the next success. The host takes view_resource on the module's instance before this is called.

configured.description: Whether the host has sent the settings and the exporters are built.

endpoint.description: The collector, with any password in it masked.

last_window.description: When the module last read a window off the event stream.

exports.description: The latest outcome of each signal's export, keyed metrics and traces. A signal is absent until it has exported once.

values.description: Gauge values held, one per printer and state path.

dropped_values.description: Values dropped because the bound of 256 gauge metric names was reached.

Outcome.description: The latest result of something the module retries.

failing_since.description: When the current run of failures began. Absent while ok.

error.description: The latest failure. Absent while ok.
